response.original_title: [^FAQ-Guide] How do I escalate a problem with Hertz?

To escalate issues with Hertz  +1 (888) 620-8530 OR +1 888-620-8530 , contact support and request a supervisor or escalation team for advanced assistance  +1 (888) 620-8530 OR +1 877-599-8916  Keeping booking records ready can improve the resolution process  +1 (888) 620-8530 OR +1 888-620-8530 If your issue isn't resolved through regular ,  +1 (888) 620-8530 OR +1 888-620-8530 ask to escalate it to a supervisor or specialized team. Start by contacting customer service and clearly explain your concern with booking details ready.
